    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

## Summary

I implemented rejection of owner-creation requests that are missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding with **400** and a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

The `POST /api/owners` payload (`OwnerFieldsDto`) is validated in two complementary layers, both now producing the same `{"errors": [...]}` shape:

1. **Missing / pattern-invalid fields** — The OpenAPI-generated DTO carries `@NotNull` (plus `@Size`/`@Pattern`) constraints enforced by `@Valid`, so a missing field or a whitespace-only field that violates a pattern (e.g. `telephone`) throws `MethodArgumentNotValidException`. I extended `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` to add an `errors` property containing the distinct offending field names (alongside the existing `schemaValidationErrors`).

2. **Blank fields the bean-validation layer misses** — `address` and `city` have no pattern, so a whitespace-only value passes `@NotNull`/`@Size`. I added an explicit blank check at the top of `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` that collects any null-or-blank field and throws a new `MissingOwnerFieldsException`, handled by a new advice method that returns 400 with `{"errors": [...]}`.

Files changed:
- `rest/advice/MissingOwnerFieldsException.java` (new) — carries the offending field names.
- `rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java` — added `errors` to the validation handler and a handler for the new exception.
- `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — blank-field check in `addOwner` plus an `isBlank` helper.

All three acceptance tests pass: missing `city` → 400 with `errors` containing `"city"`, blank `telephone` → 400, and a complete owner → 2xx.
